site.name: French Tech Copenhagen
site.tagline: The bridge between the French and Danish tech ecosystems.
site.description: French Tech Copenhagen connects French and Danish founders, investors, talent and partners through events, mentorship, and a soft-landing for French startups in Denmark.

home.aboutBody: French Tech Copenhagen is a volunteer-run community connecting the French and Danish tech ecosystems, and one of the international communities of La French Tech — the French government-led initiative, launched in 2013 and run under the Ministry of Economy, that supports and promotes startups in France and around the world. We gather founders, operators, investors, mentors and partners to grow opportunities on both sides of the bridge. Through events, network and partnerships, we help French- or Francophile-founded startups and talents land, expand and grow in Denmark.
home.upcomingBody: Breakfasts, panels, founder dinners and bigger conferences, powered by Luma.
home.newsletterBody: Monthly newsletter with events, opportunities, founder stories.

footer.tagline: Built by the community, for the community.
